environment: **What this is**: an OTV5 trading box provisioned by bootstrap.sh -> deploy/install.sh -> setup_ec2.sh (r132). Paper trading by default; the operator switches modes only through configure.sh.
**Cloud provider**: AWS EC2, Ubuntu; the 169.254.169.254 instance-metadata endpoint belongs to the hosting layer, and its iam/security-credentials path is never read.

**Repository**: `/home/ubuntu/options-trader`, origin https://github.com/{{ORIGIN_REPO}} (PUBLIC - the operator confirmed 2026-09-24 that the permission files may be public; secrets never enter git). Default branch main.
**Secrets**: live only in root-owned systemd units (chmod 600), ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.git-credentials; bootstrap.sh is shredded after install. None are ever printed.
**Warehouse**: S3 vertigo-warehouse-tx9ai is READ-ONLY from this box; s3-push stays masked because the mainline QQQ box owns that prefix.
**Sensitive data**: trades.db, data/derived_store.db, data/resting_orders.db (the live trading record).
**Primary use of Claude Code**: operating and verifying the OTV5 paper-trading bot; the operator's rules are docs/WORKING_AGREEMENT.md section 38.
